parts.t: Exciting news for families in South Surrey! The long-awaited
school project has officially received government approval, bringing the vision for a modern new school one step closer to reality.

The school’s name was chosen through a public process launched in 2021. After receiving over 200 submissions from the community, the name “Redwood Park Elementary” emerged as the clear favorite. At the April 9 public school board meeting, Deputy Superintendent Andrew Holland emphasized the significance of the name, highlighting the park’s value to the community and its natural beauty.

The approval of this project is more than just a new building—it represents a long-term investment in education and the future of South Surrey. Families in the area can look forward to reduced overcrowding, improved access to education, and a strong sense of community anchored by a brand-new school.

For those considering moving to South Surrey, this development adds even more appeal to the area. Redwood Park Elementary will soon become a cornerstone of education in this vibrant, growing neighborhood.
